name: docs import from existing CLAUDE.md
description: Convert headings of existing CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / nested CLAUDE.md files into entries, guessing feature by path and kind by wording; agent reviews the result. Migration path for existing repos.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Merged cafce68. docs import [files...] [--dry-run] [--json]: each heading with its own text becomes one entry; a section made only of top-level bullets is split into one entry per bullet. Root files go to repo.yaml unless a heading names a feature; nested files match when.paths by longest prefix, otherwise a shipped feature named after the folder is created. Kind is guessed by keywords (gotcha > howto > decision > rule > 'because' > fact). Re-import skips entries with the same summary and body. The generated render block is skipped and @import lines are reported. Exits 1 without writing if any docs file fails to load. Not handled: setext headings, CLAUDE.local.md, two-space hard breaks. EntryId.FromSummary/Unique are available for #40.
